note: Severity-tier transition and main-comparison-ARM transition are DIFFERENT questions and must not be conflated -- see per-donor rows for the full trajectory, not just first-to-last. 'days_from_onset_category_counts' separates raw-string identity from numeric validity: 'identical_non_numeric' (e.g. CV0231's Healthy/Healthy) must never be read as a resolved onset day, and an identical NUMERIC string is still only consistent with, not proof of, a baseline-only (non-re-measured) field. 'order_resolved'=False means this donor's visit order could not be determined from visit_resample_flag + collection_day alone; its 'first'/'last'/'sequence' fields reflect input row order ONLY and must not be read as chronological.
same_monocyte_state_subtype_availability: NOT independently checked this round for any multi-visit donor -- the roster's own subtype_coverage_checked_this_round column already says 'not re-checked this round' for every row; this is a real, named gap for the longitudinal feasibility question, not an assumed yes/no
